query:
MATCH (population:Spec)
WHERE population.specNumber STARTS WITH '38.5'
WITH DISTINCT population.specNumber AS specNumber
OPTIONAL MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: specNumber})
RETURN specNumber, count(DISTINCT sec.sectionId) AS sectionCount
ORDER BY sectionCount DESC, specNumber
